name: 22101 · Mclean, VA
findings: ZIP 22101 (Mclean) has 326 nonprofit organizations. 138 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 126 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (13% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 22101 (Mclean) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 22101 (Mclean) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 126 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.
